crossRefs.note: Then Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men…
Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be…
You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing…
A noise will come even to the end of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with the nations. He will enter into…
The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves.
Yahweh is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Yahweh has his way in…
It will happen in that day, that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden…
Behold, a day of Yahweh comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.
This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh…
and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them…
They went up over the width of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints, and the beloved city. Fire came down…
then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.
He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.
translations.bsb: All the many nations going out to battle against Ariel— even all who war against her, laying siege and attacking her— will be like a dream, like a vision in the night,
translations.kjv: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
translations.asv: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her stronghold, and that distress her, shall be as a dream, a vision of the night.
